verdict.rationale: SerpApi is fundamentally a structured API (query parameters, JSON/HTML/MD output), not a natural-language command interface — but it does provide markdown output 'optimized for LLMs and AI agents,' an llms.txt file, and an official MCP server (serpapi-mcp) that would let an AI agent invoke it via natural-language-driven tool calls rather than raw API parameters. This gives some agentic/natural-language accessibility, but the core product still requires structured parameters (q, location tokens, engine-specific fields) rather than accepting free-form natural language directly. missing for 10: evidence that the core API or a first-party tool parses arbitrary natural-language queries/commands itself, details on how the MCP server maps natural language to parameters, independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's natural-language usability.
